declarations.description:
Source-code field built on CodeMirror 6, which is an **optional peer dependency**: nothing is imported until an
editor mounts, and when the peer is absent the element degrades to a plain `<textarea>` carrying the same value,
the same events and the same form behaviour — only without highlighting. Install what you need alongside it:

```sh
npm install

members.name: value
members.description: The source code. Assigning it replaces the document without losing scroll position or undo history.

members.name: language
members.description: Language id: one of `BUILT_IN_LANGUAGES`, anything `languageLoader` resolves, or empty for no highlighting.

members.name: languageLoader
members.description:
Resolves a language id this package has no grammar for, to a CodeMirror `Extension`. Property only — it takes a
function, so there is no attribute for it.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name.

members.name: label
members.description: Label above the editor, when the `label` slot is empty.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name when nothing visible labels the editor.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Text shown while the document is empty.

members.name: readOnly
members.description: The document cannot be edited, but is still selectable and focusable.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Blocks interaction entirely and dims the editor.

members.name: required
members.description: The form is invalid while the value is empty.

members.name: lineNumbers
members.description: Show the line-number gutter.

members.name: wrap
members.description: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling horizontally.

members.name: autocomplete
members.description: Offer completions while typing (identifiers, and whatever the grammar contributes).

members.name: tabSize
members.description: Width of a tab stop, in characters.

members.name: error
members.description: Renders the error styling; `error-text` replaces the supporting text.

members.name: errorText
members.description: Message shown in place of the supporting text while `error` is set.

members.name: help
members.description: Help text under the editor, when the `supporting-text` slot is empty.

members.name: engineState
members.description: How far the engine got: `pending`, `ready` (CodeMirror mounted) or `basic` (textarea fallback).

members.name: dirty
members.description: Set by an edit, cleared by the `change` that follows the blur — the native commit-on-blur contract.

members.name: ready
members.description: Resolves once the engine has settled, so a host (or a test) can await the editor being live.

members.name: engine
members.description: The engine in use, or `undefined` while it is still loading.

members.name: accessibleName
members.description: What labels the editable element. CodeMirror's content node is the `textbox`, so the name has to land there.

members.name: formResetCallback
members.description: The `value` *attribute* is the default, exactly as `defaultValue` is on a native control.

members.name: stopNativeEditing
members.description:
CodeMirror edits a `contenteditable`, whose native `input` / `beforeinput` are composed and would escape the
shadow root — a consumer would see one of those *and* the component's own `input` for the same keystroke, and
would see one even for an edit `readonly` rejected. The component owns its event surface, so they stop here.

members.name: handleFallbackInput
members.description: The fallback textarea fires native `input` / `change`; only the value has to be mirrored.

events.name: ready
events.description: The engine settled, so tests and hosts can wait for it. Does not bubble.

events.name: input
events.description: The document changed. Fires on every edit.

events.name: change
events.description: The value was committed: the editor lost focus after an edit, as a native control does.
